text:
Sam Customer: Hey @support — since yesterday our embeddings calls started failing intermittently. We're seeing "dimension mismatch" errors when batching ~8 texts. Error sample below (Python client, SDK v0.12.3):
```
ValueError: embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 but got 768
Request payload: {"model": null, "inputs": [["doc1..."], ["doc2..."]], "batch_size": 8}
Stack: File "client.py", line 42, in _send
...
```
We're using the hosted embeddings endpoint via the Python SDK with our API key. Single-item requests work fine, only multi-item batches fail.

Maya Support: Thanks — can you paste a minimal repro with the SDK call and exact SDK version? Also confirm if you're using any client-side batching middleware (node-batcher / process pool / custom aggregator).

Sam Customer: Minimal snippet (Python):
```python
from redwood import EmbeddingsClient
client = EmbeddingsClient(api_key="sk-XXX")
texts = ["a","b","c","d","e","f","g","h"]
res = client.embed(texts)  # defaults, no explicit model
```
pip show -> redwood-embeddings 0.12.3

Priya DevEx: Two quick hypotheses:
1) Mixed models in a single batch (rare but can happen if callers don't pass model arg) -> server sees different dims.
2) SDK bug where model name is omitted in batched path, falling back to an older account default model with different vector size.
Can you try forcing model param: `client.embed(texts, model="text-embed-3-large")` or via curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"text-embed-3-large","input":["a","b","c","d","e","f","g","h"]}'
```

Jared Eng-ML: Reproduced locally with our test harness. Root cause: a bug in the client-side batcher in redwood-embeddings v0.12.3 (Python + TS). When parallel callers race, the batch aggregation can produce a batched request where the "model" field becomes null (race condition in request meta). Server then routes to the account default model (1536-dim) while some callers expected 768-dim -> mismatch.

Fix: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789 — guard when merging meta, always include per-item model or fail the batch. We're cutting v0.12.4 with the fix.

Workarounds:
- Explicitly pass model per call: `client.embed(texts, model="text-embed-3-large")`
- Disable client batching: set env `REDWOOD_EMBEDDINGS_BATCH_ENABLED=false`
- Add retries/backoff on client-side for embed calls (idempotent). Recommended: exponential backoff with jitter, initial wait 200ms, max attempts 5, and increase request timeout to >= 60s for large batches.

Priya DevEx: Also, if you can’t upgrade immediately, change batch_size to 1 so you won't combine different callers (cheap stopgap).

Sam Customer: Tried `client.embed(texts, model="text-embed-3-large")` — that fixed it. No more errors. Will schedule upgrade to v0.12.4. Thanks!

release-bot: :shipit: Released redwood-embeddings v0.12.4 — includes fix for batching-race and improved logging. Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/releases/tag/v0.12.4

Maya Support: Glad to hear — we'll keep this thread open for 48h. If you see recurrence please DM and we'll escalate to eng oncall. /cc @Jared

Sam Customer: One last note — we saw the same behavior in the TypeScript SDK (v0.12.3). After upgrade to v0.12.4 it resolved. Thanks all :sparkles:
